mechanical.notes: 6 cabinets, 569/1200 draws (47%), 33780/200000 tris (17%), one populated (6x48 + 257 = 545 draws base). Console clean; offline clean; boot clean (data-app-ready, render loop, 5 buttons, __qa hooks callable). ASSEMBLY VERIFIED HEADLESS (0 guard failures): equipment seated at integer U (UPS U8 3U y411-542, FMPS U12 1U y589-632, PDU pair vertical y100-2095, camera on the 2.7 m ceiling y2644-2700), rack_equipment x[1100,1938] inside a cabinet x[1000,2146]. Each device imported from its OWN folder by relative path (single source of truth), all six sharing ONE three.js instance (two copies would break instanceof across the boundary). THREE cross-asset divergences only the assembly could reveal, each reasonable and surviving six gates because nothing called >1 asset: (1) no shared builder convention (4 scene-adding build(scene) vs 2 root-returning build(mats)->{root}) — resolved with two NAMED helpers, not one that hides it; (2) no shared origin convention (base-at-0 / centred / ceiling-at-0 / offset) — resolved by seat() measuring the visible bbox and aligning THAT; (3) the cabinet is not centred on its own origin (x[-310,310] but z[-510,636]) — rail centreline measured from the cabinet's own box. And a self-caught helper bug: seat() measured the WORLD box but corrected a LOCAL position, which only works without a rotation between — the 90deg-rotated hero cabinet made the correction land sideways (rack read 1789 mm wide vs 1146). Rule recorded: measure in the space you will correct in. New scene-level guards: verifyEquipmentIsInsideItsRack (a correct device mis-placed in the scene frame — no device suite can see it), verifyScaleCoherence (six separate 1u=1m builds; a scale error makes all others look wrong at once), verifyAisleIsClear + verifyCorridorEnclosesTheAisle (enclosure a device can never check), and visibleBox everywhere (Box3 ignores `visible`; the dome's 400 mm ceiling prop + FMPS blank plates would report a 101 mm camera as 400).

notes: Inline orchestrator judgment. The ASSEMBLY is a genuine achievement — six independently-built assets in one scene, single-source-of-truth imports on one three.js instance, equipment seated at correct U positions (headless-verified, 0 guard failures), and three real cross-asset divergences (builder convention, origin convention, off-centre cabinet) plus a self-caught seat() space-mismatch bug, all surfaced only because the scene is the first thing to call more than one asset. But I cannot PASS it: the ?cam=hero-rack view — the one that shows the whole point of the scene, all six devices in one rack including the blue/red dual-feed PDU pair — renders a flat grey plane from a mis-aimed camera, so two criticals are unjudgeable, and the office-corridor context is not visible in the aisle view. Both are bounded fixes (camera target + mass/confirm the context), not an assembly rebuild. Re-capture ?cam=hero-rack (doors open) and the aisle-end context as attempt 2. The aisle massing, figure scale, and glass-LED doors are already right.
